verdict.rationale: Fastmail's JMAP API docs describe WebPush as an alternative to EventSource, with 'no permanent connection required'. WebPush is a server-to-endpoint push mechanism, so it approximates a webhook a consumer can receive. EventSource is a client-held stream and does not count. The evidence is a one-line protocol-site mention, so the details of registering a callback URL on Fastmail are unproven. Missing for 10: Fastmail-specific docs on registering a push/callback URL, documented event types and payloads, delivery or retry guarantees, and hands-on corroboration that Fastmail implements WebPush subscriptions for third-party consumers.
